sentences.en: I've been learning English for thirty days.
I can see how much I've improved.
At first, I felt unsure of myself.
sentences.ar: في البداية، كنت غير واثق من نفسي.

sentences.en: Now I can introduce myself comfortably.
I know how to ask basic questions.
I can describe my daily routine.
I can order food at a restaurant.
I can ask for directions politely.
I can explain what I need.
Some conversations are still difficult.
That's part of the learning process.
I don't understand every word yet.
But I understand the main message.
I've learned hundreds of useful sentences.
Repeating them helps me remember.
I practice speaking out loud.
I listen closely to pronunciation.
I notice new expressions in everyday life.
sentences.ar: ألاحظ تعبيرات جديدة في الحياة اليومية.

sentences.en: I sometimes make the same mistake twice.
I can learn from each mistake.
I've become more patient with myself.
My listening has improved gradually.
I can follow a short story more easily.
sentences.ar: أستطيع متابعة قصة قصيرة بسهولة أكبر.

sentences.en: I want to keep building my vocabulary.
Next month I'll focus on longer conversations.
sentences.ar: سأركز الشهر المقبل على محادثات أطول.

sentences.en: I'll also practice writing short paragraphs.
sentences.ar: سأتدرب أيضًا على كتابة فقرات قصيرة.

sentences.en: I plan to review older lessons regularly.
It's useful to track my progress.
I don't need to be perfect today.
sentences.ar: لست بحاجة إلى أن أكون مثاليًا اليوم.

sentences.en: I just need to keep going.
Consistency is becoming a habit.
I'm proud that I didn't give up.
This is only the beginning of my journey.
I'm ready for the next thirty days.

sections.heading: Getting started
paragraphs: Dina was exploring your first month. The aim was to have a clear, natural conversation in English. Dina said, “I've been learning English for thirty days.” A friend replied, “I can see how much I've improved.” Dina said, “At first, I felt unsure of myself.” A friend replied, “Now I can introduce myself comfortably.” They paused to remember the meaning. Dina said, “I know how to ask basic questions.” A friend replied, “I can describe my daily routine.” Dina said, “I can order food at a restaurant.” A friend replied, “I can ask for directions politely.” They paused to remember the meaning. Dina said, “I can explain what I need.”

sections.heading: In conversation
paragraphs: The conversation continued, and Dina practiced listening and responding with care. Dina said, “Some conversations are still difficult.” A friend replied, “That's part of the learning process.” Dina said, “I don't understand every word yet.” A friend replied, “But I understand the main message.” They paused to remember the meaning. Dina said, “I've learned hundreds of useful sentences.” A friend replied, “Repeating them helps me remember.” Dina said, “I practice speaking out loud.” A friend replied, “I listen closely to pronunciation.” They paused to remember the meaning. Dina said, “I notice new expressions in everyday life.”

sections.heading: Practicing details
paragraphs: Next, Dina practiced phrases that could help with common problems and decisions. Dina said, “I sometimes make the same mistake twice.” A friend replied, “I can learn from each mistake.” Dina said, “I've become more patient with myself.” A friend replied, “My listening has improved gradually.” They paused to remember the meaning. Dina said, “I can follow a short story more easily.” A friend replied, “I want to keep building my vocabulary.” Dina said, “Next month I'll focus on longer conversations.” A friend replied, “I'll also practice writing short paragraphs.” They paused to remember the meaning.

sections.heading: Putting it together
paragraphs: Before finishing, Dina reviewed more useful sentences and noticed real improvement. Dina said, “I plan to review older lessons regularly.” A friend replied, “It's useful to track my progress.” Dina said, “I don't need to be perfect today.” A friend replied, “I just need to keep going.” They paused to remember the meaning. Dina said, “Consistency is becoming a habit.” A friend replied, “I'm proud that I didn't give up.” Dina said, “This is only the beginning of my journey.” A friend replied, “I'm ready for the next thirty days.” They paused to remember the meaning.
